[[Nayl Klaw Tuthan]] is a [[Hydra]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Perdition Rock]].

== Locations ==
* [[Ring of Fire Islands]]
** {{NPC location|Perdition Rock}}

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Aura of Restoration}}
* {{skill icon|Glyph of Renewal}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Inferno}}
* {{skill icon|Meteor Shower}}
* {{skill icon|Phoenix}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Mahgo Claw]]

== Notes ==
* This boss can appear in any of the four possible [[spawn]] locations. It shares these locations with [[Rull Browbeater]] and [[Rwek Khawl Mawl]].
* When capturing Glyph of Renewal, the easiest method to kill this boss is to turn left (west) as soon as you enter Perdition Rock and walk towards the wall while holding the hotkey to highlight [[foe]]s. If Nayl Klaw Tuthan has spawned at the southernmost location you will be able to see it. Re[[zone]] until it shows, then fight your way there.
* Unlike other Hydras, this foe is susceptible to being [[Knock down|knocked down]].

== Trivia ==
* All Hydra bosses have one name for each head.
* Nayl Klaw Tuthan's name seems to be a play on the words "Nail", "Claw" and "Tooth".
* This might also be a reference to the phrase "fighting someone ''tooth'' and ''nail''" (claw being a term sometimes used instead of nail).
